选择与表单

上传 AsamUpload

默认 resource 模式上传后保存规范化资源，显式 native 模式维护原始 fileList。

使用场景 ​

默认 resource 模式上传后保存规范化资源，显式 native 模式维护原始 fileList。两种模式的模型、事件与实例方法各有契约。

资源上传、校验与取消 ​

示例只使用本地异步 handler，不发送网络请求。upload 返回包含 id/name/url/mimeType/size 的资源；context 提供取消信号与进度报告。maxSizeBytes/validate 在上传前检查文件。复制源码包括 handler。

const localUpload: any = async ({ file }: any, context?: any) => {
    context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: file.size });
    await new Promise((resolve?: any, reject?: any) => {
        const timer: any = setTimeout(resolve, 250);
        context.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            reject(new Error('cancelled'));
        }, { once: true });
    });
    if (context.signal.aborted)
        throw new Error('cancelled');
    context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
    return {
        id: file.name + ':' + file.size,
        name: file.name,

多文件与文件插槽 ​

multiple 模型必须是资源数组。file 插槽提供 item、file、index、remove、cancel；保留移除和取消入口。progress 由 handler 的 reportProgress 更新。

原始文件列表与手动提交 ​

mode=native 使用 v-model:fileList 和原始 httpRequest/hooks。本地 httpRequest 调用 onSuccess，不发送请求；没有 resource modelValue 或资源事件。abort/clearFiles 操作原始上传实例。

原始文件列表与手动提交

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{
				...{ mode: 'native' },
				...{
					'http-request': upload,
					'auto-upload': false,
					'on-success': () => (event = 'native success')
				}
			}"
			v-model:file-list="files"
		>
			<template #trigger>
				<AsamButton type="default"> 选择文件 </AsamButton>
			</template>
			<template #tip> 原始文件列表本地演示 </template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.submit()"> 提交列表 </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.abort()"> 取消原始请求 </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clearFiles()"> 清空列表 </AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>数量：{{ files.length }}；{{ event }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadNativeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadExpose, AsamNativeUploadProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const event = ref('尚未上传');
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = (options) => {
	options.onSuccess({ local: true });
	return Promise.resolve({ local: true });
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.density-grid {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
}

section {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
	min-width: 0;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>

四档尺寸与上下文继承 ​

四个实例分别显式使用 large、big、default、small。下面省略 size 的实例随 ConfigProvider 响应切换；显式 size 覆盖祖先。面板本身没有 size 契约的入口不附加虚构尺寸属性。

四档尺寸与上下文继承

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="density-grid">
			<section data-density="large">
				<strong> large </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="large" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.large"
						size="large"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="big">
				<strong> big </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="big" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.big"
						size="big"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="default">
				<strong> default </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="default" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.default"
						size="default"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="small">
				<strong> small </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="small" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.small"
						size="small"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :size="density">
			<section data-density="inherited">
				<div data-mode="native"><AsamUpload mode="native" :auto-upload="false" /></div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload v-model="inheritedModel" :upload="upload" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="override">
					<AsamUpload size="small" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
			</section>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'large'">继承 large</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'default'">继承 default</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'small'"> 继承 small </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'big'"> 继承 big </AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>配置提供器：{{ density }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadSizesExample' });
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamConfigProvider, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const models = reactive<Record<AsamControlSize, AsamUploadedResource | null>>({
	large: null,
	big: null,
	default: null,
	small: null
});
const inheritedModel = ref<AsamUploadedResource | null>(null);
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }) => ({
	id: file.name,
	name: file.name,
	url: '/local-demo',
	mimeType: file.type,
	size: file.size
});
const density = ref<AsamControlSize>('big');
</script>

<style scoped>

	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {

	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.density-grid {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
}

section {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
	min-width: 0;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="density-grid">
			<section data-density="large">
				<strong> large </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="large" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.large"
						size="large"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="big">
				<strong> big </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="big" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.big"
						size="big"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="default">
				<strong> default </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="default" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.default"
						size="default"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
			<section data-density="small">
				<strong> small </strong>
				<div data-mode="native">
					<AsamUpload size="small" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload
						v-model="models.small"
						size="small"
						:upload="upload"
						:auto-upload="false"
					/>
				</div>
			</section>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :size="density">
			<section data-density="inherited">
				<div data-mode="native"><AsamUpload mode="native" :auto-upload="false" /></div>
				<div data-mode="resource">
					<AsamUpload v-model="inheritedModel" :upload="upload" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
				<div data-mode="override">
					<AsamUpload size="small" mode="native" :auto-upload="false" />
				</div>
			</section>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'large'">继承 large</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'default'">继承 default</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'small'"> 继承 small </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'big'"> 继承 big </AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>配置提供器：{{ density }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadSizesExample' });
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamConfigProvider, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const models = reactive({ large: null, big: null, default: null, small: null });
const inheritedModel = ref(null);
const upload = async ({ file }) => ({
	id: file.name,
	name: file.name,
	url: '/local-demo',
	mimeType: file.type,
	size: file.size
});
const density = ref('big');
</script>

原生照片墙、缩略图与受控重排 ​

native 模式完整承接 text、picture、picture-card 三种 listType。 完整说明。

照片墙、缩略图、校验与重排

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="controls">
			<div class="control-field">
				<label for="control-listType">列表类型</label>
				<AsamSelect id="control-listType" v-model="listType">
					<AsamOption :label="'text'" :value="'text'">text</AsamOption>
					<AsamOption :label="'picture'" :value="'picture'">picture</AsamOption>
					<AsamOption :label="'picture-card'" :value="'picture-card'"
						>picture-card</AsamOption
					>
				</AsamSelect>
			</div>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="allowRemoval"> 允许移除</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="custom"> 自定义缩略图</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled"> 禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-model:file-list="files"
			mode="native"
			:list-type="listType"
			:auto-upload="false"
			:http-request="upload"
			:disabled="disabled"
			accept="image/*"
			crossorigin="anonymous"
			:on-progress="(event) => progresses.push(event.percent)"
			:on-change="() => changes++"
			:before-remove="beforeRemove"
			:before-upload="beforeUpload"
			:on-preview="preview"
			:on-success="(_response, file) => (result = `已上传 ${file.name}`)"
			:on-error="(_error, file) => (result = `上传失败 ${file.name}`)"
			:on-remove="(file) => (result = `已移除 ${file.name}`)"
		>
			<template #tip>选择图片后可手动提交；移除由异步 beforeRemove 判定。</template>
			<template v-if="custom" #file="{ file, index }">
				<div class="thumbnail">
					<AsamImage v-if="file.url" :src="file.url" :alt="file.name" />
					<span>{{ index }}：{{ file.name }} / {{ file.status }}</span>
					<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="disabled" @click="preview(file)">
						预览 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton
					 type="default"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="control?.handleRemove(file)"
					>
						移除 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="disabled" @click="control?.abort(file)">
						取消 {{ file.name }}
					</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.submit()">提交照片</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="files.reverse()">重排照片</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clearFiles(['success'])"
				>清除成功照片</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<output>
			{{ result }}；{{ files.map((file) => file.name).join(',') }}；进度
			{{ progresses.join(',') }}；change 次数 {{ changes }}
		</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadGalleryExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamImage,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps, AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const listType = ref<'text' | 'picture' | 'picture-card'>('picture-card');
const custom = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const allowRemoval = ref(false);
const result = ref('照片墙与受控重排');
const progresses = ref<number[]>([]);
const changes = ref(0);
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	options.onProgress(Object.assign(new ProgressEvent('progress'), { percent: 50 }));
	if (options.file.name.includes('fail')) throw new Error('本地失败演示');
	return { local: true, name: options.file.name };
};
const beforeUpload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeUpload']> = (file) => {
	const valid = file.type.startsWith('image/') && file.size <= 1024 * 1024;
	if (!valid) result.value = '只接受 1MB 以内图片';
	return valid;
};
const beforeRemove: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['beforeRemove']> = async () => {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
	if (!allowRemoval.value) result.value = '移除被 beforeRemove 拒绝';
	return allowRemoval.value;
};
const preview: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onPreview']> = (file) => {
	result.value = `预览 ${file.name}`;
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.control-field {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

.controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.thumbnail {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-xs);
}

.thumbnail img {
	width: 80px;
	height: 60px;
	object-fit: contain;
}
</style>

目录选择和拖放路径 ​

目录上传由 native 的 directory 承接。 完整说明。

目录选择与拖放相对路径

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamUpload
			v-model:file-list="files"
			mode="native"
			directory
			drag
			multiple
			:http-request="upload"
			:on-change="change"
			:on-success="(_response, file) => completed.push(file.name)"
		>
			<template #default>拖入目录，或点击选择目录</template>
			<template #tip>
				目录展开为文件；相对路径直接来自 UploadRawFile.webkitRelativePath。
			</template>
		</AsamUpload>

	</div>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadDirectoryExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const paths = ref<string[]>([]);
const completed = ref<string[]>([]);
const change: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onChange']> = (_file, list) => {
	paths.value = list.map((file) => file.raw?.webkitRelativePath || file.name);
};
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	return { local: true, path: options.file.webkitRelativePath };
};
</script>

数量限制、覆盖和请求钩子 ​

限制覆盖、原生请求与手动提交

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-model:file-list="files"
			mode="native"
			:limit="1"
			:auto-upload="false"
			:http-request="upload"
			:on-exceed="replace"
			action="/local-demonstration"
			method="put"
			:headers="{ 'X-Demo': 'local' }"
			:data="data"
			name="attachment"
			with-credentials
			:show-file-list="true"
			:on-change="(file) => (result = `已选择 ${file.name}`)"
		>
			<template #trigger><AsamButton type="default">选择或替换文件</AsamButton></template>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.submit()">手动发送</AsamButton>
			<template #tip>
				超过 limit 后先 clearFiles，再 handleStart；本地 handler 显示实际请求参数。
			</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.abort()">abort 实例</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clearFiles()">清空原始文件</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ result }}</output>
		<pre>{{ request }}</pre>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadHooksExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamUpload, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadProps, AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamNativeUploadExpose>();
const files = ref<NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['fileList']>>([]);
const result = ref('原生请求参数与覆盖前一个文件');
const request = ref('');
let uid = Date.now();
const replace: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['onExceed']> = (selected) => {
	const file = selected[0];
	if (!file) return;
	control.value?.clearFiles();
	control.value?.handleStart(Object.assign(file, { uid: ++uid }));
};
const data: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['data']> = async (file) => ({
	category: 'demo',
	original: file.name
});
const upload: NonNullable<AsamNativeUploadProps['httpRequest']> = async (options) => {
	request.value = JSON.stringify({
		action: options.action,
		method: options.method,
		headers: options.headers,
		data: options.data,
		name: options.filename,
		withCredentials: options.withCredentials,
		file: options.file.name
	});
	result.value = '本地请求已完成';
	return { local: true };
};
</script>

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

upload handler 和 request 二选一。 完整说明。

资源 transport、转换、取消和回填

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled"> 禁用资源操作</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure"> transport 失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="invalid"> transform 失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamUpload
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			multiple
			:request="request"
			:limit="2"
			:auto-upload="false"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:max-size-bytes="1024"
			field-name="document"
			:data="{ category: 'demo' }"
			:validate="(file) => file.name.endsWith('.txt') || '只接受 TXT'"
			@success="(_resource, item) => (event = `success:${item.name}`)"
			@progress="(item) => (event = `progress:${item.percent}`)"
			@error="(error) => (event = `${error.kind}:${error.message}`)"
			@cancelled="(item) => (event = `cancelled:${item.name}`)"
			@remove="(resource) => (event = `remove:${resource.name}`)"
		>
			<template #tip>独立 provider，不影响页面中其他示例；最多两个资源。</template>
		</AsamUpload>
		<div class="controls">
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.submit()">提交资源</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.cancel()">取消资源请求</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="control?.clear()">清空资源</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="runtime.setScope(String(++scope))"
				>切换资源作用域</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="fill">外部回填</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<output>{{ event }}；请求：{{ input }}；资源：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamUploadRequestExample' });
import { onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamUpload,
	AsamButton,
	asamDataRuntimeKey,
	createAsamDataRuntime
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadExpose, AsamUploadRequestConfig } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<AsamUploadedResource[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const disabled = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);
const invalid = ref(false);
const event = ref('尚未提交');
const input = ref('');
const scope = ref(0);
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
runtime.install({
	upload: async (config, payload, context) => {
		input.value = `${config.method}:${config.url}:${payload.fieldName}:${payload.data?.category}`;
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0, total: payload.file.size });
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 150);
			context.signal.addEventListener(
				'abort',
				() => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new Error('cancelled'));
				},
				{ once: true }
			);
		});
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('本地 transport 失败');
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: payload.file.size, total: payload.file.size });
		return invalid.value ? null : { key: payload.file.name };
	}
});
provide(asamDataRuntimeKey, runtime);
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
const request: AsamUploadRequestConfig = {
	url: '/local-resource',
	method: 'put',
	params: { demo: true },
	transform(response, { file }) {
		if (
			!response ||
			typeof response !== 'object' ||
			!('key' in response) ||
			typeof response.key !== 'string'
		)
			throw new Error('响应缺少资源 key');
		return {
			id: response.key,
			name: file.name,
			url: '/local/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
			mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
			size: file.size
		};
	}
};
function fill(): void {
	value.value = [
		{ id: 'seed', name: 'seed.txt', url: '/seed.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', size: 4 }
	];
}
</script>

	gap: var(--asam-space-md);

.controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

			mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
			size: file.size
		};
	}
};
function fill() {
	value.value = [
		{ id: 'seed', name: 'seed.txt', url: '/seed.txt', mimeType: 'text/plain', size: 4 }
	];
}
</script>

cancel/clear/作用域失效及卸载中止 context，迟到完成不会写回；进度、成功、错误、cancelled、remove 事件保持各自 payload。 完整说明。

API 阅读方式 ​

下方 Props、Events、Slots、Exposes 按当前实际公开类型与运行默认值生成。组合属性按分支生效，不能任意混搭值模式。标为“未知 / 未声明”的默认值不代表 false 或空值。源码区域提供对应语言的独立 Demo.vue，可直接复制或下载；本地辅助组件、数据和素材已内联到当前文件。

用法与契约补充说明 ​

原生照片墙、缩略图与受控重排 ​

native 模式完整承接 text、picture、picture-card 三种 listType。onPreview 处理预览动作；beforeUpload 可同步/异步拒绝文件或返回替换后的 File/Blob，返回 false/Promise rejection 会阻止上传。beforeRemove 可同步/异步拒绝移除，onRemove 在实际移除后调用；onChange 会在选择、成功、失败时收到当前列表。native file 插槽原样接收原生 { file, index }，移除和取消通过实例 handleRemove(file) / abort(file) 调用。item/remove/cancel 仅属于 resource file 插槽；旧 native 用法需按照片墙示例迁移。

原生照片墙、缩略图与受控重排 ​

v-model:fileList 为受控原始列表，使用方可重排或外部替换；uid 保持文件身份。picture 和 picture-card 的缩略图使用 file.url；组件负责自身生成的对象 URL 生命周期。crossorigin 按实际图片来源配置。disabled 禁止选择和原生列表操作；资源模式也禁止默认取消、移除按钮，实例方法仍由使用方控制。

隐藏列表后的头像替换 ​

下面使用 native、showFileList=false 和 default 插槽呈现选择入口，成功后以头像替换入口内容。beforeUpload 拒绝非 JPG 或超过 2 MiB 的文件；accept 是选择器提示，不能替代验证。httpRequest 是本地 Promise，onSuccess 只在成功后用原始 File 创建预览，不发网络请求。拒绝文件不会替换已有头像。

目录选择和拖放路径 ​

目录上传由 native 的 directory 承接。目录选择依赖浏览器 webkitdirectory 支持；拖放目录展开后保留原始文件的 webkitRelativePath，而不是只留下最后一级文件名。multiple 接收展开的文件集合，httpRequest 的 options.file 同样保留路径，存储端可以据此构造相对目录。

目录选择和拖放路径 ​

resource 模式保持规范化资源模型，其 transport 输入是原始 File；不会擅自将目录层次塞入资源 id/url。目录选择 UI 和照片墙由 native 明确承接；resource 的 file 插槽可呈现宿主已有资源缩略图。需要资源路径时由 upload/request transform 按宿主协议生成，不能将 native fileList 与 resource modelValue 混搭。

数量限制、覆盖和请求钩子 ​

limit 与 onExceed 组合控制超量选择。覆盖单文件时先 clearFiles，再给新 File 赋 uid 并 handleStart；handleRemove 走原始移除流程。autoUpload=false 将文件留在 ready，submit 发送待传列表。showFileList、accept、drag、multiple、disabled 直接控制原生 UI。trigger 是选择入口，存在 trigger 时 default 可放独立提交动作，tip 为提示区域。

数量限制、覆盖和请求钩子 ​

原生请求参数 action/method/headers/name/data/withCredentials 交给 httpRequest；data 支持对象、函数和 Promise。onProgress 接收进度事件，onSuccess/onError 接收结果和原始列表。自定义 httpRequest 可返回 Promise（由组件调用成功/失败钩子）或 XMLHttpRequest（abort 可中止其请求）；Promise 的物理取消由自定义请求实现负责，不能仅凭调用 abort 宣称异步操作已终止。clearFiles 可按 ready/uploading/success/fail 过滤，禁止在 beforeUpload 中清列表。

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

upload handler 和 request 二选一。request 包含 url、post/put、params、同步 transform，实际上传由注入的 provider.upload 执行；示例以独立 runtime/provide 隔离，不改变其他示例。transport 输入保留 File、fieldName 和字符串/Blob data；context.signal 与 reportProgress 分别支持取消和进度。loaded/total 必须有效，未知 total 显示无百分比状态；超量进度不当成成功。

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

transform 返回合法 id/name/url/mimeType/size 资源，失败、重复 id 和错误 metadata 不写入模型。maxSizeBytes/validate/limit 在传输前判定；配置错误、transport 错误和 transform 错误分别通过 error.kind 表明来源。未完成或失败文件不进入 modelValue。多文件模型必须数组，单文件空值为 null；外部回填重新显示已有资源，资源模型与 native 原始文件列表保持分离。

资源 transport、转换、取消与回填 ​

cancel/clear/作用域失效及卸载中止 context，迟到完成不会写回；进度、成功、错误、cancelled、remove 事件保持各自 payload。disabled 禁止默认资源选择、取消和移除操作；自定义 file 插槽的按钮和外部实例方法由使用方控制。实例 abort/clearFiles/handleStart/handleRemove 为原生文件桥接，submit/cancel/clear 为资源操作；全部操作的结果以真实模型与列表为准。

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 扩展为 resource/native 双模式与四档密度。resource 的 upload 与 request 二选一；request 需要 provider 上传 transport 与 transform，不混用 native action。resource 公开 submit/cancel/clear；native 公开 abort、submit、clearFiles、handleStart、handleRemove。单个资源空值为 null，多资源为空数组。
